headlines.title: Crypto giant Binance attempting to recover $6.3bn stolen in hack linked to North Korea
headlines.summary: The cyber-attack, which the company describes as complex, is believed to be the largest ever of its kind.

headlines.title: Kärcher boss: Less regulation, more action to get Europe and Germany fit again
headlines.summary: Kärcher, best known for its pressure washers, recorded €3.5 billion in sales in 2025 and employs 17,000 people worldwide. Its CEO warns of a 'perfect storm' and calls for a fitness plan for Germany and Europe.

headlines.title: DW
headlines.summary: News, Analysis and Service from Germany and Europe - in 30 Languages

headlines.title: Hundreds of thousands of protesters march across France for third week in a row
headlines.summary: Cities across Europe faced wave of protests against rising cost of living.

headlines.title: US tech stocks see sharp falls as AI spending nears $1tn
headlines.summary: Shares in Intel continue to fall while the tech-heavy Nasdaq opens at its lowest level in more than two months.

headlines.title: Where in Europe do people spend over 40% of their income on housing?
headlines.summary: Housing costs take up more than 40% of disposable income for millions of Europeans. Euronews Business takes a closer look at which countries are hit hardest, with experts explaining the drivers.

headlines.title: India increases growth forecast for fiscal year
headlines.summary: India s Ministry of Finance has increased its growth forecasts for the current fiscal year. But it also warned about inflation, particularly for fuel and energy, amid continued instability in the Middle East.

headlines.title: Putin s potential G20 comeback risks normalizing Russian war crimes, says Kallas
headlines.summary: The EU's foreign policy chief also rebuffed reported calls from the Pentagon for allies to tone done their criticism of the Kremlin.

headlines.title: What we know about Binance's $6.3bn hack
headlines.summary: Cyber correspondent Joe Tidy explains more about what is suspected to be the biggest hack in history.

headlines.title: EU to impose €2 fee on all packages entering the bloc as of 1 November
headlines.summary: A €3 fee also came into force in July, leading to a 60% drop in small parcel imports over three months. The new rules aim to counter imports from Chinese platforms, whose low prices threaten European retailers.

headlines.title: Volkswagen logs Q3 operating loss of €5.86 billion on Porsche writedown
headlines.summary: The Volkswagen Group has filed its worst quarterly performance since the height of the Dieselgate scandal in 2015. Share prices climbed in response, however, perhaps because the bad news was so well signposted.

headlines.title: Merz surprised by Asian pushback to Made in Europe plan for car industry
headlines.summary: The German chancellor said the Franco-German plan to restrict car subsidies "sparked considerable concern" among East Asian capitals.

headlines.title: City of London chief tops UK Black Powerlist
headlines.summary: Ian Thomas, who heads the City of London Corporation, tops the Black Powerlist in its 21st year.

headlines.title: Islamic states prosecutors call for global enforcement coalition
headlines.summary: Law enforcement heads from 46 Islamic states gather in Baku to tackle cross-border financial crime, artificial intelligence and international asset recovery.

headlines.title: Russia shadow fleet sanctions: Can the EU act without US?
headlines.summary: The US is reportedly considering ways to convert dark tankers into legitimate vessels, allowing them to transport crude oil that is not subject to sanctions.

headlines.title: Burnham open to formal apology for Britain s slave trade
headlines.summary: The U.K. prime minister however rejected calls for Britain to pay financial reparations.

headlines.title: How Poundland grew from a market stall to a high street giant
headlines.summary: The retail giant - which started life at a Wolverhampton market - is now at threat of collapse.

headlines.title: AstraZeneca profit jumps 23% on cancer drugs as it unveils major savings plan
headlines.summary: AstraZeneca's net profit jumped 23% in the third quarter on booming sales of its cancer drugs, as the British drugmaker unveiled a programme to save $1.5 billion (€1.34bn) a year to invest back into developing new medicines.

headlines.title: EU s Made in Europe push unnerves global auto suppliers
headlines.summary: In shielding Europe s carmakers from Chinese rivals, the EU risks hurting close partners from Turkey and Morocco to Japan and South Korea. Billions in trade and hundreds of thousands of European jobs are at stake.

headlines.title: Zelenskyy urges US to speed up Patriot deliveries
headlines.summary: Washington approved the sale of 500 interceptors to counter Russian ballistic missile attacks.

trend_headline: EU 규제와 지정학 충격 속 자동차·에너지 대전환
